fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the 1927–1928 winter tourist season in Greater Miami; complaints about fraudulent tropical fruit dealers; discussion of employment-bureau fees and other petty graft; coverage of Miami city-finance controversy and the trial/acquittal of city cashier W. A. Means; reporting on convention funding disputes involving the Elks and city commissioners; notes on federal prosecution in a coastguardsman killing case; political items and a notice for the Miami Beach Democratic Club; and sports coverage of boxing bouts at the Coliseum, alongside society/entertainment columns and extensive local advertising.
